text:
emma: Quick sync — prepping a joint marketplace tile + demo with Datadog and our HW SI next week. Need dashboards, traces, an OTEL mapping, and a short runbook. Who can pick up dashboard JSON + demo script?
pranav: I can own the dashboards. Will need example metrics + trace payloads from the runtime to build panels. @marco can you drop a sample trace and the metric names?
marco: Yep, will paste snippets in a sec. Also flagging that we should show cache hit rate + batching impact. KPIs: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, gpu_util, cache_hit_pct, error_rate.
emma: Perfect list. Also include a tiny cost slide: cost per 1k tokens with and without batching. @julia can you do the cost chart?
julia: Doing it — will need expected QPS scenarios. Suggest low/medium/high: 1rps, 10rps, 100rps. Also happy to convert into a single-panel time-series + a small table.
pranav: For Datadog tile packaging: we need dashboard JSON, a mapping doc for metrics -> DD names, and a 90s demo script. For OTEL traces include resource attributes and canonical span names. Example attributes to include: service.name=redwood-inference, deployment.environment=prod, device.gpu_model.
marco: sample OTLP payload (trimmed):
```json
{"resource":{"service.name":"redwood-inference","host.id":"nv-ctrl-7","device.gpu_model":"A100-SXM4"},"spans":[{"name":"inference.request","duration_ms":142,"attributes":{"model":"redwood/gptx-13b","tokens_in":24,"tokens_out":96,"kv_cache_hit":true}}]}
```
marco: For metrics names we emit: redwood.inference.latency_ms, redwood.inference.tokens_per_sec, redwood.inference.cache_hit_ratio, redwood.inference.gpu_util_pct, redwood.inference.errors_total. We'll provide a Grafana-like JSON for dashboard layout but convert to DD panels.
emma: Nice. Ops need an embargo and release window. ops-bot: "embargo: 2025-05-12T17:00:00-07:00"
pranav: Also want a short SI enablement checklist: 1) install OTLP collector config sample, 2) import dashboard JSON, 3) run smoke script, 4) validate traces. I'll draft it and post as markdown.
julia: Timeline check — demo recording on Tue 2025-05-13 10:00 PT, final dashboard + runbook must be in repo by Mon EOD. Can we commit by Mon noon?
marco: I'll push trace and metric examples by today EOD. Pranav will have dashboard draft by tomorrow lunchtime.
emma: Owners assigned: dashboards & DD packaging = pranav, trace/metric examples = marco, cost panel = julia, runbook + SI checklist = pranav. Action: sync quick call tomorrow 9:30 PT to review.
deploy-bot: tile build succeeds in staging (build #342) :white_check_mark:
emma: Great — thanks all. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly or drop in #partnerships. :thumbsup:
